svg.text: UML Use Case Diagram (POS, Inventory, Purchasing, Supplier Portal, AI Demand Forecasting, Reports, RBAC & CMS)

g.text: Admin and Owner can grant Staff or Custom Role accounts granular page-level permissions across
POS, Wastage, Products, Inventory, Suppliers, Purchase Orders, Reports, Audit Logs, and Forecasting.
Transaction Logs remain strictly Owner-only; CMS & Account Management are restricted to Admin / Owner.
